sampling.algorithm: One shared 32-bit stream. Sort each pool by ascending claim ID using code-unit order. In laws, predictions, then AI-and-money order, perform the first n forward Fisher–Yates swaps. At step i swap i with i + floor(random × (N − i)); retain the first n records in draw order.

targeted.rule: Judgment sample drawn after the seeded draw, excluding all seeded IDs.

blindOrder: Fetched origin and branched from origin/main. Before finalising the verdicts I used the user-supplied project instructions, permitted dataset files and collection criteria, and the cited sources or explicitly identified alternate copies.

Drew the three seeded strata, then selected ten distinct targeted records based on the risks visible in the admitted data. I opened no file in review/ or research/ and did not open docs/backlog.md or release/CHANGELOG.md before the blind push.

Attempted fresh direct HTTP sequentially with at least eight seconds from the end of one request to the next on the same hostname. Used the cited capture for archive-specific records and as a fallback when live retrieval failed. Cleaned signed query parameters and used no Wikipedia evidence.

Validated the two reports in scratch space before writing them to review/. The blind reports are the first commit. The privacy scan and any reading of excluded repository material follow the first push.
limits: A material error changes the claim’s documentary meaning, criterion outcome, voice, or structured semantics. Minor slips preserve the substantive conclusion. Cannot check identifies a missing expression or missing evidence for a necessary check.

I compared wording and locators in retrieved HTML and PDFs, allowing line wraps and typesetting where they preserve wording. I used fresh page-image OCR for Dartmouth, Turing and Simon–Newell, checked relevant context and documented differing expressions. A successful HTTP status can still be an access challenge or service error.

Dates refer to the cited expression, statement or act. An as-enacted law’s approval date can be right even when the metadata date kind is wrong. Earliest-located checks assess the cited witness and its assigned role under the collection’s scope. I did not rerun the original discovery searches.
Every sampled prediction record preserves the distinction between prediction and fulfilment. The audit assesses the documentary record only.
